certificates_issued_complete.name: certificates_issued_complete
certificates_issued_complete.value: "certificates"."status" <> 'issued' or ("certificates"."reference_number" is not null and "certificates"."issued_on" is not null)

exams_window.name: exams_window
exams_window.value: "exams"."available_from" is null or "exams"."available_until" is null or "exams"."available_until" > "exams"."available_from"

materials_has_content.name: materials_has_content
materials_has_content.value: "materials"."file_key" is not null or "materials"."external_url" is not null
